mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pallet (pallet_id, cargo_id, pickup_x, pickup_y, pickup_heading, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{palletId}, #{cargoId}, #{pickupX}, #{pickupY}, #{pickupHeading}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, pallet_id, cargo_id, pickup_x, pickup_y, pickup_heading, status, created_at, updated_at FROM pallet WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, pallet_id, cargo_id, pickup_x, pickup_y, pickup_heading, status, created_at, updated_at FROM pallet WHERE pallet_id = #{palletId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM pallet WHERE pallet_id = #{palletId}
